name: 902 DXF Prep
description: Batch DXF cleanup & prep for Boost 902 part files. Pop-up process picker (all selected by default) runs any combination of: IGES CONVERT folder + QTY sheet, DXF rename/sort for AutoCAD review, recombine + reconcile against the PO spreadsheet (extras moved to EXTRA, missing parts listed, (Nx) quantity prefixes).
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: Have the batch's part-files folder ready - either the SigmaNest DXF export or the EB folder that holds the IGES and un-cleaned DXFs side by side. You pick this folder when the app runs.
Make sure the batch's PO pricing spreadsheet is in that folder or its parent - the app reads the part list and quantities from it.
Do the SigmaNest VM import/export and the AutoCAD Layer-12 macro pass yourself; those steps stay manual and happen between the app's steps.
how_it_works: Pick the working folder, then choose which of the three steps to run (all are checked by default, so one run walks the whole workflow).
Step 1 builds the IGES CONVERT folder and writes a QTY sheet listing each part and how many are needed.
Step 2 renames the exported DXFs to clean part numbers and sorts them into folders of 25 for AutoCAD review.
Step 3 recombines the folders and reconciles them against the PO - extras go to an EXTRA folder, missing parts are listed, and multi-quantity parts get an (Nx) prefix.
output: An IGES CONVERT folder and a '{batch} QTY.xlsx' sheet at the batch root.
DXFs renamed to part numbers, sorted into numbered subfolders, then recombined.
A '{batch} - MISSING PARTS.txt' report and an EXTRA folder for anything not on the PO.
